## H1 versus H2/H3

| Hypothesis from exact C9O d80e3ebac7db186f33c073074abc20da25dc041e | Distinct evidential prediction | Current C9P result |
|---|---|---|
| H1 enacted material practice | Actual preceding A-enacted operations under a specific project and material constraint qualify a scoped recurrent practice; the committed practice changes eligibility/selection at independently admitted E2 under its own lawful action rule. Remove one qualifying actual operation while retaining labels/current options to test the claimed source edge. | No enacted action/source object or project resolver. History/offer/material strings suffice; static fixed practice route. It does not instantiate the proposal. |
| H2 relational participation | Independently owned P initiative and actual mutual activity can qualify actor-local embedding; nominal membership/access without participation cannot. Remove P's performed offer while holding institutional standing constant. | No P actor history, competing agenda, owned action or genuine mutual participation. No embedding rule implemented. |
| H3 incompatible enacted projects | Two actually pursued obligations become materially incompatible; removing either enactment or incompatibility blocks this specific new tension without erasing older unrelated state. No compulsory reconciliation, pathology or consciousness is implied. | No project/obligation/action/conflict representation. No tension rule implemented. |

C9O's H1-first recommendation is defensible as a narrower experimental docket because it can avoid private mental-state and relationship mutation claims. It is not evidence that the hypothesis is true or ready for issuance. Two independently attested historical actions could operationalize recurrence in one finite assay, but the count must be justified by the competent scientific owner for that bounded operation. It is neither a universal acquisition threshold nor sufficient evidence of future action. C9P's code does not even enforce the proposed finite two-distinct-act prerequisite.

Meaningful distinct actors require P's independently sourced prior projects, obligations, material access and performed choices to constrain P's offer/refusal. C9P merely accepts `other_person_offer_ref`; the same focal author can invent it. Changing “wrench” to “spanner” changes event identity, not the causal organization of two persons. No refusal quota or random independence score would solve that problem.

The history tests preserve the present event/options while changing source qualification. Their REDs show absent qualification in the implementation. They do **not** establish a contrary human-learning law. Unknown/unwitnessed history is not proof a person lacks ability; absence of source must lead to typed uncertainty, no-change or hold at the governed predicate, rather than a trait inference.

## Machine knowledge, actor uptake and performed action

The adopted R2 noncollapse law distinguishes machine reading, actor uptake, recruitment, access, durable belief and self-explanation. C9P stores conditioning metadata, invents `uptake:<event>:<ref>` strings and emits the same proposal. It does not establish A saw/heard/understood an offer, acted, remembered or formed a belief. Observer-private content may be machine-available while actor-inaccessible; the observer trial's CREATE does not grant epistemic truth.

A material offer is not the focal actor's completed inspection. A target write is not another person's response. A receipt that names an actuator and imaginary occurrence is not the occurrence itself. A state read and route label are not later action selection/execution. Those distinctions are not optional scientific embellishments; they determine whether the proposed H1 causal chain exists at all.

S1's exact 0d47fe863671d1e1d57f26102462be6595c5d7ea critique applies here at the same grain: authored labels can demonstrate computational contrasts without warranted psychology; independent current capability/source evidence cannot be replaced by list membership; otherness needs separately developing projects and material consequences. This review imports S1's argument as a source, not its verdict as a test oracle. C9P's own source and the new executions establish the present findings.

C9O's reconciliation of memory returns correctly refuses to turn parallel ADP016/017 provenance into a serial formation law. This review neither reruns those separate courts nor upgrades their claims. ADP016 formation still needs admitted experiential basis and a qualified effect; ADP017 access/knowledge/belief needs its own lawful current source/claim/access graph. H1 does not justify hidden autobiographical memory or first-person explanation.
